metadata.lookahead_policy: outcome candles open at or after replay timestamp; no candle data before the signal timestamp is scored
metadata.incomplete_outcome_policy: INCOMPLETE_DATA unless all 864 expected 5m candles from the signal timestamp through the 72h expiry are contiguous or TP/SL is reached before a gap
metadata.forming_candle_policy: reconstruct 1h/4h/15m in-progress candles from completed 5m bars before the boundary plus boundary 5m open only; no post-boundary OHLCV is exposed
metadata.harness_mode: scanner_v5.main historical injection; 3-way chronological chunk merge

short_rsi_adx_research.warning: Retrospective candidate comparisons are diagnostic only; candidate selection requires separate chronological validation.

di_directional_comparison.definition: Bearish DI confirmation means -DI > +DI at signal time; diagnostic only, not a production gate.

support_distance_bands.definition: Distance from signal-time price to nearest support below price; closer support may constrain SHORT downside.

price_to_ema20_comparison.definition: Signal-time price relative to completed-candle EMA20; descriptive only.

rsi_60_70_adx_20_25_ema200.definition: EMA200 computed from completed 1H closes at signal time; below means signal-time 1H close < EMA200

multi_feature_candidate_discovery.split_method: chronological first two thirds for candidate ranking; final third reported as holdout
multi_feature_candidate_discovery.ranking_objective: TP3 retention minus SL retention, with both retention values measured against the same chronological split baseline; score is scaled down when candidate retains less than 35% of split signals; discovery-only ranking
